memoryNotes.note: Wendy keeps warning everyone about dangerous cables and impending electrical sparks.
Arduino advocates for reckless wiring and digital pins without resistors.
NVIDIA is obsessed with accelerating ten thousand threads and minds at once.
Scailab complains that the real world does not match the simulation angles.
Ignite-next wants to throw the robot onto the assembly line and please the clapping client.
